node.title: Actual line and plane capacities bound eigen-root core incidence
node.statement: For a zero-free polynomial operator3 carrier with one-dimensional F-eigenspaces and actual line/plane capacities q1,q2 with2q1<=q2, the eigen-root core incidence is at most D times0,q2,q2+q1,3q2/2 for0,1,2,3 F-eigenvalues. A fixed M-subset and a strict second-moment inequality give a pair-count cap, with the natural non-eigen intersection bound D-1 retained. Repeated eigenvalues and common-zero exclusion are explicit; no unconditional capacity or Prize bound is assumed.
